import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

spending_columns = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
average_spending = df[spending_columns].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x=average_spending.values, y=average_spending.index, orient='h')
plt.xlabel('Average Amount Spent')
plt.ylabel('Product Category')
plt.title('Average Customer Spending by Product Category')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
